item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`LM.forward` chooses the outbound route solely from `self.model_type`, so the example needs two `dspy.LM` instances against the same endpoint: one with `model_type=\"chat\"` and one with `model_type=\"text\"`.","span_ids":["lm_forward_dispatch"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"When `forward` is called with `prompt=\"ping\"` and no explicit `messages`, DSPy first constructs `messages=[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"ping\"}]`.","span_ids":["lm_forward_dispatch"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The chat route goes through `litellm_completion`, which calls `litellm.completion`; intercepting `litellm.completion` is therefore the correct way to capture the outbound chat request, and that captured request should still carry the `messages` payload.","span_ids":["lm_forward_dispatch","chat_wrapper_call"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The text route goes through `litellm_text_completion`, which consumes the `messages` list, joins message contents with `\"\\n\\n\"`, and appends the literal `BEGIN RESPONSE:` marker; for `ping`, the outbound prompt is exactly `ping\\n\\nBEGIN RESPONSE:`.","span_ids":["lm_forward_dispatch","text_prompt_call"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"Before calling LiteLLM text completion, DSPy rewrites a model like `openai/my-text-model` to `text-completion-openai/my-text-model`.","span_ids":["text_extract","text_prompt_call"]},{"claim_id":"c6","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The text route extracts `api_key` and `api_base` from the request and forwards them explicitly, while the chat route passes remaining request fields through `**request`; using the same fake `api_base` on both LMs is therefore observable in the captured calls.","span_ids":["chat_wrapper_call","text_extract"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"lm_forward_dispatch","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":159,"end_line":188},{"span_id":"chat_wrapper_call","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":385,"end_line":399},{"span_id":"text_extract","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":403,"end_line":415},{"span_id":"text_prompt_call","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":417,"end_line":430}]}
